items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They used to go to church a lot, the bass player – Briscoe – Ted Briscoe, from Washington, D.C.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band?

Shorts McConnell, playing trumpet. On bass was – oh boy. I forget. I ccould see him. The bass player, he used to go to the Catholic Church, and Shorts McConnell. Shorts used to hit all the high notes with Bill Eckstine and Earl Hines. Then he had sort of lost his chops. It was there, but it wasn’t the same as it used to be. They used to go to church a lot, the bass player – Briscoe – Ted Briscoe, from Washington, D.C., and Lester Young nicknamed them the Religious Brothers. He had a nickname for everybody. He’d…
What was the nickname he had for you?
